terms.comment: Of people, animals, the sea and the weather: “gentle, quiet, still, calm, mild, peaceful” (Lewis & Short). See also calmly, calm down.

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 286.
